defect_confirmed: requirements.txt co-installed opencv-python==4.12.0.88 and opencv-python-headless==4.13.0.92, which provide the same cv2 namespace. The live dev venv reproduces this exactly.

gui_audit.conclusion: The repository contains no OpenCV GUI call sites, so the headless provider is sufficient for every path the repository runs.

implementation: base layer declares NO OpenCV provider, making the conflict structurally impossible
both providers version-aligned so a profile swap does not change the cv2 API level
repo_health.dependency_conflicts() is a required offline-release section and fails CI when both are present
torch/torchvision explicitly NOT treated as a conflict (legitimate co-installation)
other_conflicts_found: none beyond OpenCV; scanned for duplicate namespace providers (pytorch/tensorflow/jax/faiss) and found none co-installed. Reported rather than acted on, per scope.
remaining_blockers: The primary developer venv still has BOTH OpenCV providers installed. The new gate now reports it as FAIL, which is the intended behaviour; the operator must run 'pip uninstall -y opencv-python' (or reinstall requirements-ci.txt) to make it PASS. Not changed automatically because the venv is outside the repository.
title: Dependency profile and OpenCV conflict
